scope: Controlled binary posterior mechanism test; adaptation of released0.4B, not language pretraining or a general benchmark claim
model: tied bidirectional LongRWKV A1; no hidden loops or gate modulation; binary normalized native-token head; report actual parameters
checkpoint_selection: fixed terminal; smoke updates discarded; all seeds retained
optimizer: AdamW lr1e-4 constant beta(.9,.95) eps1e-8 weightdecay.01 gradclip1.0
precision: FP32 parameters and optimizer; BF16 autocast
objective: uniform stage t1..8; independent target mask probability t/8; loss8/(t*N)*maskedCEsum; empty masks retained; prefix immutable
data: uniform Y in GF2^8; C=A Y; rank4 systematic or four pairparities; equal families; canonical labeled structures disjoint train/dev/test; fresh syndrome/surface permutation
output_support: two native bit token IDs only; does not test full vocabulary generation
evaluation: 16 test conditions per family, 32 draws each, seven samplers; 64 separate calibration conditions per family across8stages; exactjointKL on2conditions per family for four fixed policies
information_set: oracle A-based free coordinate set, then complement; exactly two neural calls, no algebraic solution substitution
random_halves: independent fixed percondition partition; exactly two calls; same target batchsizes
metrics: exact joint KL on small fixedpolicy audit
falsification: Low oracle conditional competence makes learned schedule comparison inconclusive; no new positive claim from validity alone
inference: three seed-specific results and equal-seed summary; uncertainty conditional on checkpoints; no precise training-population inference from3seeds
novelty: Exact algebraic oracle mechanism is established independently; this experiment does not itself establish mathematical novelty
